title: UPLOTS: A Unified Pretrained Language Model for Constrained Time-series Generation
abstract: arXiv:2606.10466v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In time-series generation, existing approaches typically handcraft ortrain a separate model for each dataset, which hinders their scalability and fails to leverage shared temporal structures across domains. To address this fragmentation, we propose UPLOTS, a Unified, Prompt-guided Language model framework fOr constrained Time-Series Generation across diverse domains. Instead of building task-specific models, UPLOTS leverages a single pre-trained transformer backbone guided by learned constraint prompts, enabling on-demand generation with precise pattern control. One key innovation is our dynamic multi-dataset loss re-weighting and prompt-to-pattern mapping, which allows UPLOTS to internalize diverse temporal structures during training and conditionally generate them at inference. We evaluate UPLOTS on four real-world benchmarks and multiple constraint settings, including peak-period, calendar, load-level, and volatility pattern

translated_title: UPLOTS：一个用于受限时间序列生成的统一预训练语言模型
translated_abstract: 在时间序列生成领域，现有方法通常需要为每个数据集手工设计或单独训练一个模型，这阻碍了其可扩展性，也无法利用跨领域共享的时间结构。为解决这种碎片化问题，我们提出了 UPLOTS——一个统一的、由提示引导的语言模型框架，用于跨多样化领域的受限时间序列生成。UPLOTS 无需构建特定任务的模型，而是利用单一预训练 Transformer 骨干网络，通过学习到的约束提示进行引导，实现按需生成与精确的模式控制。其关键创新之一是动态多数据集损失重加权与提示到模式的映射机制，使 UPLOTS 能够在训练过程中内化多样化的时间结构，并在推理时按条件生成这些结构。我们在四个真实世界基准数据集和多种约束设置（包括峰值周期、日历、负载水平和波动率模式）上对 UPLOTS 进行了评估。
tldr: UPLOTS 提出了一个由学习到的约束提示引导的统一预训练语言模型框架，借助动态多数据集损失重加权和提示到模式映射机制，实现了跨领域的按需受限时间序列生成与精确模式控制。
